_metadata.description: Privacy and retention defaults for household and small-office use.

requirements.title: Sensitive network metadata is retention-limited by default
requirements.description: The scenario shall default to minimal retention for DNS query visibility and device activity, make query-log visibility explicit, and separate household privacy defaults from small-office audit defaults.

validation.notes: Add policy and settings tests tagged [REQ:NM-P0-008] for default retention, visibility gates, and profile-specific audit behavior.
